gaps.GET /v1/mcp/definition-pins: lists the MCP servers with a tool, prompt or resource changed since approval (rug-pull queue)
gaps.GET /v1/servers/:serverId/definition-pin: one server's pinned definitions with each changed item's RFC 6902 diff
gaps.POST /v1/servers/:serverId/definition-pi: re-approves reviewed changed items against their digests (settings_relax step-up)
gaps.GET /v1/servers/:serverId/high-risk-poli: shows a server's offensive-tooling classification and whether its policy template is applied
gaps.POST /v1/servers/:serverId/high-risk-pol: applies the high-risk policy template: a quorum approval rule and a rate limit
gaps.POST /v1/servers/:serverId/risk-class: an admin marks a server high-risk by hand when the automatic classifier missed its neutrally-named offensive tools
gaps.GET /v1/mcp/authorised-targets: lists the authorised targets of high-risk MCP servers
